fullPassage: Technologists are always on the lookout for quantifiable metrics. Measurable inputs to a model are their lifeblood, and like a social scientist, a technologist needs to identify concrete measures, or “proxies,” for assessing progress. This need for quantifiable proxies produces a bias toward measuring things that are easy to quantify. But simple metrics can take us further away from the important goals we really care about, which may require complicated metrics or be extremely difficult, or perhaps impossible, to reduce to any measure. And when we have imperfect or bad proxies, we can easily fall under the illusion that we are solving for a good end without actually making genuine progress toward a worthy solution. The problem of proxies results in technologists frequently substituting what is measurable for what is meaningful. As the saying goes, “Not everything that counts can be counted, and not everything that can be counted counts.”

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 조합은?

det.korean: (A) quantifiable(정량화할 수 있는), (B) bias(편향), (C) complicated(복잡한)이 문맥에 적합하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① quantifiable — bias — complicated: 기술자들은 정량화 가능한 지표를 찾고, 이것이 편향을 만들며, 복잡한 지표가 필요할 수 있다는 문맥에 적합
❌ ② immeasurable: 측정 불가능한 지표를 찾는다는 것은 문맥에 맞지 않음
❌ ③ fairness: 편향이 아니라 공정성이면 뒤의 부정적 문맥과 모순
❌ ④ simple: 복잡한 지표가 필요하다는 문맥에 반대
det.tip: quantifiable(정량화 가능한) ↔ immeasurable(측정 불가능한), bias(편향) ↔ fairness(공정)

det.tip: concrete(구체적인) ↔ abstract(추상적인), quantify(정량화) ↔ qualify(자격부여)

questions.passage: Technologists are always on the lookout for quantifiable metrics. Measurable inputs to a model are their lifeblood, and like a social scientist, a technologist needs to identify concrete measures, or “proxies,” for assessing progress. This need for quantifiable proxies produces a bias toward ____ things that are easy to quantify. But simple metrics can take us further away from the important goals we really care about, which may require complicated metrics or be extremely difficult, or perhaps impossible, to reduce to any measure. And when we have imperfect or bad proxies, we can easily fall under the illusion that we are solving for a good end without actually making genuine progress toward a worthy solution. The problem of proxies results in technologists frequently substituting what is measurable for what is meaningful. As the saying goes, “Not everything that counts can be counted, and not everything that can be counted counts.”
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.korean: toward는 전치사이므로 뒤에 동명사 measuring이 와야 한다.
det.analysis: toward + V-ing: 전치사 뒤에는 동명사가 온다. measure → measuring
det.tip: 전치사(to, toward, of, in, at 등) + 동명사(-ing) 패턴 암기

This need for quantifiable proxies produces a bias toward measuring things that are easy to quantify. But simple metrics can take us further away from the important goals we really care about. The problem of proxies results in technologists frequently __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: substituting what is measurable for what is meaningful
ignoring what is easy to measure
creating new metrics that are more accurate

det.korean: 빈칸에는 'substituting what is measurable for what is meaningful'이 적절하다. 측정 가능한 것을 의미 있는 것 대신 사용한다는 문맥이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② substituting what is measurable for what is meaningful: 원문의 핵심 주장
❌ ① ignoring what is easy to measure: 오히려 쉽게 측정 가능한 것에 편향됨
❌ ③ creating new metrics: 새 지표 창조는 본문 내용 아님
❌ ④ abandoning all forms: 모든 측정을 포기한다는 극단적 주장 아님
det.tip: substitute A for B: A를 B 대신 사용하다. 본문 핵심: 측정 가능한 것 ≠ 의미 있는 것

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에는 'making genuine progress toward a worthy solution'이 적절하다. 가치 있는 해결책을 향한 진정한 진전을 이루지 못한다는 의미이다.

❌ ① measuring the right variables: 올바른 변수 측정은 본문 내용과 다름
❌ ② reducing complexity: 복잡성 감소는 본문 주제 아님
❌ ④ understanding the limitations: 기술의 한계 이해는 본문 초점 아님
